decisions.description: Gaps the owner decided in earlier Backfills. trial.ts approve leaves them out of the gap list while their file is unchanged.

path.description: From the repo root, e.g. frontend/src/lib/http.ts.

unit.description: The Unit's bare name. Omitted: every Unit of the file.

lines.description: The lines the decision is about, e.g. "12-28". For the reader; matching uses path and unit only.

decision.description: declined: not worth testing. unreachable: no unit test can exercise it. kept-as-is: a Suspected Defect whose behaviour the owner keeps.

pr.description: The PR where the owner decided it.

blob.description: The file's git blob id when decided (git hash-object).
